short: a collection with a defined first and last element: getFirst, getLast, reversed. java 21.
constant on average over many calls, even though an occasional call (like a resize) costs O(n).
an array used as a ring: head and tail indexes wrap around, so nothing ever shifts. ArrayDeque.
one slot of a hash table's array. keys whose hashes map to the same index share it.
two different keys landing in the same bucket. guaranteed to happen; the table chains them.
a LinkedHashMap mode where every get moves the entry to the end, so the head is least recently used.
a cache that evicts the least recently used entry. a LinkedHashMap in access order plus removeEldestEntry.
a self-balancing binary search tree. recolors and rotates on insert so its height stays O(log n). TreeMap.
a sorted map you can search around: floorKey, ceilingKey, headMap, tailMap, subMap.
a set of enum constants stored as bits in a long, one bit per ordinal.
a tree where every parent beats its children, stored level by level in an array. PriorityQueue.
a read-only wrapper around a collection. blocks writes through itself, but shows changes to the original.
a counter every structural change bumps. iterators compare it to detect changes behind their back.
a sort that keeps equal elements in their original order. java's object sort is stable.
the stable merge sort java uses for objects. finds runs that are already sorted and merges them.
